exact_statement: For every Boolean seed f on n>=1 uniform bits with I(f)>0, the explicit basis-character tagged family F_t(x,a,b)=(-1)^(a dot b+c_b dot x)g_t(x), g_t=z product of t disjoint copies of f, k_t=tn+1, m_t=ceil(log2(k_t+1)), N_t=2^m_t, c_b=e_b for b<k_t and zero otherwise, has pairwise distinct bent data branches, dependent spectral marginals with mutual information >=h2(1/N_t), H(F_t)=tH(f)+2m_t and I(F_t)=tI(f)+J_t with m_t<J_t<m_t+2; hence its full H/I tends to H(f)/I(f). The optimal FEI constant on distinct correlated bent-branch address selectors equals the universal constant, possibly infinity. For every bent-branch selector with d data bits, H=d+E H(sigma_t), I=d/2+E I(sigma_t) with Boolean phase rows sigma_t, so a violation at C>=2 descends to a smaller phase row. For F=(-1)^(a dot b)h_b(x), a physical b-first paired stopping tree removes exactly 2m entropy and m influence while retaining E H(h_b), and aggregate erasure B(F)=m+E B(h_b)+sum_j H(S_j|V,S_-j).

exact_statement: For any Boolean seed g, any m>=1 and any character-tag map c:F_2^m->F_2^k, the actual lift F(x,a,b)=(-1)^(a dot b+c_b dot x)g(x) has H(F)=H(g)+2m, B(F)=B(g)+2m-J and D(F)=D(g)+J, where J=sum_j E_s_-j JS(p_g translated by c_(s_-j,0),p_g translated by c_(s_-j,1)) lies in [0,m]. J=0 iff p_g is invariant under the subspace generated by adjacent tag differences. The A079 balanced tensor basis-tag lift simultaneously preserves limiting H/I, B/I and, for H(seed)>0, B/H; its distinct correlated bent-branch class has optimal erasure supremum equal to the universal K_E. For a seed normalized by character multiplication to Inf_i<=1/2 with R=H/I>2 and eta=D/H>0, any tagged lift of t disjoint copies with arbitrary fresh parity coordinates satisfies H=tH(seed)+2m, D>=tD(seed), I>=tI(seed)+m. Hence if epsilon=D(F)/H(F)<=eta, H(F)/I(F)<=2/[1+(2/R-1)epsilon/eta]; epsilon->0 forces limsup H/I<=2, whereas H/I->R forces liminf D/H>=eta. For an unnormalized seed the same bounds hold with I_*=sum_i min(Inf_i,1-Inf_i); hence every seed with original H/I>2 and D>0 is also excluded from ratio-preserving near-erasure admission in this family. These are scoped correlated-tag transport/admission results and do not prove universal FEI.
